title: Playtime Tracker
description: A plugin for tracking users' playtime.
body:
Playtime Tracker is a Paper plugin that automatically records every player’s total server playtime and displays it in a clean, easy-to-use GUI. Open /playtime to browse tracked players with their head icon, live online status, first join date, last seen date, and total playtime down to the second.

The plugin saves data between restarts, tracks all players who have joined the server, and keeps the interface simple for both staff and regular players. It’s designed for servers that want a lightweight, visual way to check activity without dealing with complicated commands or external databases.
